messages.マッチに勝つと余った嫉妬資源を足りない資源へ変換でき、パッシブで強敵に威力減少も: An Envy Resonance E.G.O with an Unbreakable Coin that, on Clash Win, converts spare Envy resources into missing resources, with a passive that also inflicts Power Down on strong enemies.
messages.資源の変換: マッチ勝利時、嫉妬共鳴の数だけ嫉妬資源を消耗し、最も少ない資源を1: **Resource conversion**: On Clash Win, spends Envy resources equal to Envy Resonance and gains the resources she has least of, 1 at a time (up to 4, 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 6 at Ⅳ).
messages.マッチ敗北時: 最終威力が4下がる代わりに、嫉妬共鳴数×5のバリアを得る(最大2: **On Clash Lose**: Final Power drops by 4, but she gains Shield of Envy Resonance×5 (up to 20, 25 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 30 at Ⅳ). The conversion only works on a win, so use it when she can win.
messages.一方攻撃に注意: 破壊不能コインで、一方攻撃では「破壊されずに的中時」の回復が発: **Beware one-sided attacks**: It has an Unbreakable Coin, and in one-sided attacks, the healing "on hit without being broken" does not trigger.
messages.デバフと回復: 的中時に針2・釘1(解析Ⅲから呪い1)を付与する。破壊されずに的: **Debuffs and healing**: Inflicts 2 Needles and 1 Nails on hit (plus 1 Curse from Threadspin Ⅲ). When it hits without being broken, heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio by 6% of max HP (8% at Ⅲ, 10% at Ⅳ) (allies other than herself must have an Envy basic attack).
messages.パッシブ「呪いの罰ゲーム」: マッチ勝利時に対象へ嫉妬ダメージ4。自分か対象の体: **Passive — Loser's Penalty: Voodoo**: Deals 4 Envy damage to the target on Clash Win. If her or the target's HP is below 33%, inflicts 1 Power Down next turn (once per turn).
messages.嫉妬共鳴を高く保てる編成で、スキル1の代わりに撃って嫉妬資源を他の資源に替える。: In teams that can keep Envy Resonance high, fire it in place of Skill 1 to trade Envy resources for other resources. It is good for securing resources that are hard to produce with Identity skills.
messages.嫉妬主体でない編成では、ほぼパッシブ目当てのE.G.Oになると考えられる。: In teams that are not Envy-centered, it is likely an E.G.O used mostly for its passive.
messages.必要資源は色欲1・嫉妬3、精神消耗は覚醒15。使用中の罪悪耐性は、怠惰・憂鬱が脆: It requires 1 Lust and 3 Envy, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 15. While in use, her Sin resistances switch to Fatal to Sloth and Gloom, Endured against Envy, and Normal for the rest.
messages.侵蝕スキルは1枠3コインで、嫉妬共鳴に応じた広域化とデバフが中心。詳細はスキル欄: The Corrosion skill is a single 3-Coin slot centered on multi-target attacks and debuffs based on Envy Resonance. See the skill section for details.
messages.Ⅲ: 変換量・回復量・バリア量が増え、呪い1が加わる。嫉妬編成でよく使うなら価値: **Ⅲ**: Increases the conversion amount, healing, and Shield, and adds 1 Curse. Valuable if you use it often in Envy teams.
messages.Ⅳ: Ⅲとほぼ同じ項目がさらに強化される。余裕があれば。: **Ⅳ**: Strengthens nearly the same items as Ⅲ further. If you can spare it.
messages.蜘蛛の巣中指の親方: 嫉妬のスキルが中心で、嫉妬完全共鳴6を前提にした効果を持ち: **[The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115)**: Centered on Envy skills, with effects that assume 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, boosting this E.G.O's conversion amount and Shield.
